gloss: to throw in; to invest; to cast (a vote)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {投|とう}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to throw in; to cast into
definitions.explanation: To throw or drop something into a place, such as casting a stone into water or throwing oneself into something.

definitions.gloss: to invest; to put in (resources, effort)
definitions.explanation: To commit money, resources, or effort toward a purpose.
To submit a vote in an election or poll.

examples.japanese: {石|いし}を{池|いけ}に{投|とう}じた。
examples.english: I threw a stone into the pond.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{身|み}を{投|とう}じるように{海|うみ}に{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: He plunged into the sea as if throwing himself in.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}くして{政治|せいじ}の{世界|せかい}に{身|み}を{投|とう}じた。
examples.english: At a young age, he threw himself into the world of politics.

examples.japanese: {多額|たがく}の{資金|しきん}を{投|とう}じた。
examples.english: A large amount of money was invested.

examples.japanese: このプロジェクトには{莫大|ばくだい}な{予算|よさん}が{投|とう}じられている。
examples.english: An enormous budget has been invested in this project.

examples.japanese: {開発|かいはつ}に{多|おお}くの{時間|じかん}と{労力|ろうりょく}を{投|とう}じてきた。
examples.english: A great deal of time and effort has been invested in development.

examples.japanese: {一票|いっぴょう}を{投|とう}じた。
{賛成|さんせい}に{票|ひょう}を{投|とう}じる{人|ひと}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: Many people cast their votes in favor.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}は{選挙|せんきょ}で{自分|じぶん}の{意思|いし}を{示|しめ}すために{一票|いっぴょう}を{投|とう}じるべきだ。
examples.english: Citizens should cast their votes to express their will in elections.

notes:
An ichidan verb (じる form of {投|とう}ずる) meaning to throw into, invest, or cast. A somewhat formal and literary verb that covers physical throwing, financial/resource investment, and voting.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {身|み}を{投|とう}じる — to throw oneself into (an activity, a cause); to devote oneself
- {一票|いっぴょう}を{投|とう}じる — to cast a vote
- {一石|いっせき}を{投|とう}じる — to make waves; to raise an issue (lit. "throw a stone")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資金|しきん}を{投|とう}じる — to invest funds
- {予算|よさん}を{投|とう}じる — to invest a budget
- {票|ひょう}を{投|とう}じる — to cast a vote
- {身|み}を{投|とう}じる — to throw oneself into

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {投資|とうし}する — to invest (financially); specifically about financial investment, while {投|とう}じる is broader
- {投|な}げる — to throw; the everyday word for physical throwing, while {投|とう}じる is more literary
